summary: Run existing test, lint and build commands on SSH hosts with working-tree sync, per-host locking and structured results.
description: Wrap existing project commands as named rr tasks that can run on configured SSH hosts. Working-tree synchronization, host failover and per-host locking support remote checks, while structured results point agents to failures and logs. The shared task file contains no personal host details. Host configuration and credentials remain the user's responsibility, and every command continues to work locally; stacks verify still runs locally.
seoDescription: Shared rr tasks for running existing test, lint and build commands on SSH hosts, with working-tree sync, host locking and structured results.

projectExamples.title: Remote Rust checks
projectExamples.description: A desktop app whose Rust and React checks run on remote build machines, returning structured failures and paths to full logs.

projectExamples.title: Remote full-stack checks
projectExamples.description: A Python and React app whose backend and frontend checks run as separate remote tasks, with failing tests and full logs reported to contributors.

plain.whatItIs: Runs a project's existing tests and checks on remote computers you reach over SSH, a remote login method, and reports the results.
goodAt: Running checks on a computer that has tools your own computer lacks
Listing failing tests with file and line, so coding assistants can read the results
Running separate test areas at the same time
notGoodAt: Setting up the remote computers themselves; you do that separately.
Replacing local checks: every command still works on your own computer.

requests: move slow test runs off my laptop onto an SSH machine
share named remote tasks while keeping host details in personal configuration
run separate test areas in parallel without changing their commands
give coding agents concise test failures and paths to full logs
